sentences.text: The parties are present before this Court and have filed a joint affidavit stating that they have amicably resolved the dispute among themselves.

In terms of settlement, they have agreed to dissolve their marriage mutually and a petition for dissolving their marriage is pending consideration before the Court concerned.
4. The respondent No.2 has agreed to withdraw all the allegations against the petitioner, and has no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings against the petitioner.

In terms of settlement, the petitioner/husband had agreed to pay a sum of Rs.27,00,000/- to his wife towards permanent alimony, and in terms of settlement, the petitioner had paid the said amount to the wife and the same is acknowledged by her who is present before this Court.
5. The joint affidavit is placed on record.

6. Though the offences alleged are cognizable and non compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the NC: 2023:KHC:46033 parties have amicably resolved their dispute among themselves,
it would be a futile exercise, if the investigation is allowed to be continued, since the probability of police filing the charge sheet is unlikely, in view of the settlement.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i. Criminal petition is allowed.
ii. The impugned first information report in Cr.No.185/2023 registered by Basavanagudi Women Police Station is hereby quashed.
In view of the disposal of the petition, pending I.A. does not survive for consideration.
